pkg.@CoverLetterBody:
Dear Leadership Team,

As an accomplished technology executive, I am excited about the opportunity to lead eMoney Advisor's engineering organization into an AI-first, product-centric ecosystem. My leadership philosophy emphasizes aligning strategic technology initiatives with customer needs, resulting in innovative solutions that drive business growth and operational efficiency.

Throughout my career, I have successfully led large-scale digital transformation initiatives that enhance platform interoperability and customer-centric product roadmaps. For example, I orchestrated a multi-year transformation that reduced costs by $3M while modernizing our SaaS solution pipeline. Additionally, my hands-on experience in cloud migrations has improved system reliability to 99.99% uptime and reduced infrastructure spend by 30%.

I am inspired by eMoney Advisor's mission to empower financial professionals through innovative solutions and believe my commitment to a culture of continuous learning and innovation aligns well with your values. As a collaborative leader, I excel in fostering high-performing teams that embrace accountability and drive results.

I am eager to discuss how my experience aligns with the goals of eMoney Advisor and to explore how I can contribute to your mission. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,  
Von Ellis

Collaborated with CTO and CPO to design a 3-year technology roadmap, securing a $13M budget increase for a Software Center of Excellence. Negotiated strategic alliances with AWS, ESRI, and Cloud BI Vendors to enable AI-powered analytics adoption.
pkg.WorkHistoryBullets2: Led an acquired business cloud migration to AWS and Kubernetes, increasing system reliability to 99.99% uptime while reducing infrastructure spend by 30%. Spearheaded technical due diligence for multiple acquisitions, enabling 15% faster time-to-market for acquired products. Established a white-labeled BI and analytics platform partnership, contributing to 25% increase in operational response times and retention rates. Designed and implemented OKRs and monthly executive ops reviews, increasing engineering efficiency and aligning execution with business goals.
pkg.WorkHistoryBullets3: Led a major operational overhaul, modernizing legacy infrastructure and improving engineering efficiency by 45% through standardization, custom tool development, automation and third-party DevOps contracts. Implemented complex report automation, eliminating manual data entry and reducing operational costs by $3M annually. Redesigned a predictive analytics suite, converting a consultative service into a scalable digital experience, driving 60% revenue growth and 30% higher retention rates through personalized insights and real-time decision support.
pkg.WorkHistoryBullets4: Architected a real-time asset tracking platform, reducing data retrieval time by 70% and enabling data-driven operational decision-making. Deployed a GIS-powered field operations information system, increasing efficiency by 50% and enabling real-time mobile workflows for hundreds of field engineers and customers. Implemented automated reporting systems including governance policies, ensuring regulatory compliance and reducing manual reporting efforts by 80%. Developed a SaaS platform integrating real-time data collection, mobile applications, data modeling, and automated reporting, improving revenue-earning operational efficiency by 60% through predictive analytics.
